files.purpose: Holds the CSV buffer; now appends one row per published day record.

methods.name: _on_day_records
methods.purpose: Turns each published day record in the measurement window into one row; skips replayed days.

files.purpose: Headless runner; exports the CSV and decides the exit code.

methods.name: _run
methods.purpose: Runs the measured days, exports the CSV, calls _check_csv and returns 6 with a count or date-order message. Prints recorder_method=day_records_worker_v1 (or day_records_main_v1 with zero warmup) in the result line.

methods.name: _check_csv
methods.purpose: Counts rows and requires the committed-day column to read first_day, first_day+1, ... in order; returns exit 6 otherwise. Replaces the count-only _csv_data_row_count.

files.purpose: Recorder tests: batched, late and missing days.

methods.name: _test_committed_day_export
methods.purpose: Batched and late publications give days 6, 7, 8 once each; _check_csv returns exit 0.

methods.name: _test_missing_committed_day
methods.purpose: Days 6 and 8 without 7: _check_csv returns exit 6 for expected count 3 and for a matching count of 2.

files.purpose: Shared perf comparison tool used by the factory's merge gate; now records and compares the recorder method.

methods.name: validate_day_csv
methods.purpose: Checks the daily CSV: method matches the warmup clock, ordered days, t_sus_ms empty, commit stamps increasing.

methods.name: validate_perf_run
methods.purpose: Rejects unknown recorder methods and routes daily CSVs to validate_day_csv.

methods.name: perf_round
methods.purpose: Stores each round's recorder_method; a script with no marker becomes unversioned:<sha256 of the runner>.

methods.name: assess
methods.purpose: Different methods on base and head: needs_human, no metric rows, reason 'incompatible recorder methods'; result hashes still compared.

files.purpose: Unit tests for the comparison tool.

methods.name: test_refuses_throughput_comparison_between_different_recorder_methods
methods.purpose: Head throughput doubled but methods differ: needs_human, rows empty.

methods.name: test_refuses_a_record_with_mixed_or_missing_methods
methods.purpose: Mixed or missing methods within one side: fail.

flows.title: A base before PR 85 meets a head after it

trigger.label: perf_change_check.py compare BASE HEAD (the factory's merge gate runs this)

steps.name: perf_round
steps.via: base's older runner prints no marker, so the tool labels it unversioned:<script hash>

steps.name: assess
steps.via: methods differ: rows = [], status needs_human, reason 'incompatible recorder methods'

outcome.label: exit 2 (needs_human), report with no metric rows

trigger.label: perf_change_check.py measure runs the headless runner

steps.name: _on_day_records
steps.via: simulation_day_records signal from the runtime host

steps.name: _check_csv
steps.via: ordered = ordered and cells[day_column] == str(first_day + rows)

steps.name: _run
steps.via: csv_check.exit_code == 6: push_error count mismatch or 'CSV days must be ordered', return 6

outcome.label: The round fails with exit 6 instead of passing on a matching count
